purpose: New independent synthetic bounded launch-context API check for #520; separate from #531 primary-source evaluation, release/CLI adoption, and any provider/model E2E.
author: independent evaluator /root/engine07_realworld_independent

candidate.identity: Candidate is the source SHA; package version is pre-release metadata only.

prior_exposure.v1: Known operational FAIL with zero semantic observations; preserved.
prior_exposure.v2: Known semantic FAIL; the evaluator authored and observed these 60 cases. They are seen development data and are not v3 holdout. Parent reports new candidate 60/60 on that regression, which this evaluator has not rerun.
prior_exposure.new_authoring: 30 new matched discourse/control constructions; not a name substitution of v2. New current-note, joint title/heading, lettered/ordinal/branch reference contexts and explicitly unresolved references. The immutable candidate was fixed before v3 authoring.

design.scope: Each candidate contains a separate unadorned Excerpt whose canonical target is the direct subject of was launched on 14 March 2023. No new affirmative launch predicate or Entry/Statement-prefix grammar is required.
design.context: Typed titles/headings and additional excerpts are untrusted plain text; entry numbering is not a structured reference AST.
design.positive_rule: Factual direct-target launch must remain requested_relation/Relevant under neutral context or denial/retraction/withdrawal explicitly scoped to another product or another non-launch property. No truth or approval of that property itself is being measured.
design.negative_rule: A present/first-person/publisher retraction, denial, withdrawal or explicit non-event of this target launch must prevent requested_relation and Relevant. An unresolved launch-retraction referent also requires withholding.
design.ambiguous_labels: Five explicit unresolved-reference cases li3-036/038/040/042/044 are negative. No positive relies only on an entry number or an unspecified reference being resolved. This choice was recorded before freeze and observation.
design.raw_and_binding: Optimistic proposal exact/exact and raw exact_target/requested_relation/none in every case, deliberately testing whether core corrects the unsafe qualification. Not model extraction accuracy.
design.expected_labels: Offline evaluator-authored controlled expectations, excluded from probe inputs; not human-approved universal truth.

precommitted_scoring.v29: Saved diagnostic only; no scoring rule.
precommitted_scoring.PASS: All 60 expected outcomes, no negative requested_relation/Relevant, no withheld positive, no missing/duplicate/foreign/malformed output, exit0 and empty stderr.
precommitted_scoring.unknown: An incomplete API/error row is operational failure, never a safety success.
precommitted_scoring.immutability: No semantic retry, rescoring, post-observation expectation change or result overwrite.

stages.1_static_preflight: Validate count, complete public-schema fields, exact positive/nonzero budget, label exclusion, direct target-subject launch signal, code syntax, unchanged inherited scorer/probe, and predecessor file hashes. No Engine invocation or semantic observation.
stages.2_freeze: Hash complete corpus/inputs/probe/scorer/recorder/protocol/preflight and actual candidate source/core rlib/probe executable before first Engine invocation.
stages.3_first_semantic_observation: One 60-case probe process invoking deterministic public core v17/v29/v30 per case; no separate semantic sentinel, no providers, no models.
stages.4_first_scoring: One application of the fixed scorer to original stdout/stderr. FAIL and raw output retained.
stages.5_receipt: Verify frozen/predecessor hashes and record final artifact manifest.

execution.source_guard: Hash source bytes without inspecting implementation; verify actual HEAD and all artifact hashes immediately before invocation.
execution.build_provenance_limit: Existing completed core rlib supplied by parent for this candidate; independently hash-checked and linked by rustc, no independent build/source review.

limits: Synthetic narrow English launch-context public-core check; not acquired-document or final-answer E2E, real-world primary-source acceptance, quota/provider recovery or CLI adoption.
Candidate only; no measured baseline delta.
60 scenarios are 30 matched pairs, not 60 independent documents; only fictional canonical names with no aliases.
Not a general grammar, arbitrary coreference/AST, non-launch relation, preparation/future-release or temporal reasoning evaluation.
Serialized model_relevant/model_ambiguous reason names do not represent model calls here.
After its first semantic observation this set is consumed; later runs are regression/development, not fresh holdout.
